series.name: Official AUX global IDU error-code list (25 codes, IDU + ODU split)
series.notes: Official AUX global error-codes page (auxair.com/global, TH mirror identical) — 25-code list with 10 IDU + 15 ODU rows. High (official). Per-product-line causes at us.auxair.com/error-codes-faq.

title.ur: Indoor unit ka overcurrent protection

meaning.en: The indoor unit's running current has passed the protection limit, so the system shut itself down to prevent damage.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ka chalta hua current protection ki had se paar kar gaya, is liye system ne nuqsaan rokne ke liye apne aap ko band kar liya.

causes.en: Indoor fan or indoor motor drawing excessive current
causes.ur: Indoor fan ya motor zyada current le raha hai

causes.en: Indoor controller fault or a short in the indoor wiring
causes.ur: Indoor controller kharab hai ya indoor wiring mein short hai

solutions.en: Switch off at the breaker for about ten minutes, then restart and watch whether the code returns
solutions.ur: Breaker se taqreeban das minute ke liye band karein, phir restart karein aur dekhein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Have a technician measure the indoor current and check the motor plus the indoor controller
solutions.ur: Technician se indoor current measure karwaein aur motor ke sath indoor controller bhi check karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Also confirmed on the Thailand mirror. The 2021 AUX service manual carries the same code with a current-transformer inspection path.
notes.ur: Yeh Thailand wali mirror par bhi confirm hua hai. 2021 AUX service manual mein bhi yehi code hai, jismein current-transformer check karne ka rasta diya gaya hai.

title.ur: Indoor unit ke room temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor controller reads the room sensor as short-circuited or open, so the reading cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: Indoor controller room sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh raha hai, is liye us par bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta.

causes.en: Dirty, damp or disconnected room-temperature sensor
causes.ur: Room-temperature sensor ganda, geela ya disconnect ho gaya hai

causes.en: Damaged sensor wiring or a fault on the indoor main board
causes.ur: Sensor wiring kharab hai ya indoor main board par fault hai

solutions.en: Power-cycle the unit and clean the filters and sensor area, then check whether the code clears
solutions.ur: Unit ka power-cycle karein, filters aur sensor wali jagah saaf karein, phir check karein ke code clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the code stays, have the sensor resistance and the indoor board tested
solutions.ur: Agar code bhi raha to sensor resistance aur indoor board ko test karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Same meaning in the 2021 service manual, which gives a 15 kohm reference at 25 C for inverter models. Retailer-facing PK articles also use E1 for sensors, but those articles are brand-agnostic.
notes.ur: 2021 service manual mein bhi yahi matlab hai, jismein inverter models ke liye 25 C par 15 kohm ki reference di gayi hai. PK ki retailer articles mein bhi E1 sensors ke liye use hoti hai, lekin woh articles brand-agnostic hain.

title.ur: Outdoor condenser coil sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor board reads the condenser (outdoor coil) sensor as short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board condenser (outdoor coil) sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor coil sensor failed or its plug is loose
causes.ur: Outdoor coil sensor fail ho gaya ya uska plug dheela hai

causes.en: Sensor wiring damaged by weather, or a fault on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Mausam se sensor wiring kharab ho gayi, ya outdoor board par fault hai

solutions.en: Inspect and re-seat the sensor connector, then restart the unit
solutions.ur: Sensor connector ko check karke dobara lagaein, phir unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure the sensor against its nominal resistance and replace it if out of range
solutions.ur: Sensor ki nominal resistance se compare karke measure karein aur agar out-of-range ho to sensor badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Official page points at the indoor main board as the place to look, which does not match the outdoor-side meaning of the text - recorded as a source inconsistency. The 2021 service manual treats E2 as an outdoor coil sensor read by the outdoor controller.
notes.ur: Official page ke mutabiq ghaur indoor main board lena chahiye, jo text ke outdoor side ke matlab se match nahi karti - is liye source inconsistency ke tor par note kiya gaya. 2021 service manual E2 ko outdoor coil sensor maanta hai jo outdoor controller parh raha hai.

title.ur: Indoor evaporator coil sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor controller reads the indoor coil sensor as short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Indoor controller indoor coil sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh raha hai.

causes.en: Indoor coil sensor failed, damp or disconnected
causes.ur: Indoor coil sensor fail ho gaya, geela hai ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Damaged sensor lead or fault on the indoor main board
causes.ur: Sensor lead kharab hai ya indoor main board par fault hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor connector for moisture and corrosion, then restart
solutions.ur: Sensor connector mein nami aur zangat ke liye check karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Compare the sensor reading with the room temperature and replace the sensor if it does not match
solutions.ur: Sensor ki reading room temperature se compare karein aur agar match na kare to sensor badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Official page lists an outdoor motor or PCB as the place to look, which is inconsistent with an indoor coil sensor - recorded. Same meaning in the 2021 service manual (5 kohm or 20 kohm reference).
notes.ur: Official page mein ghaur ke liye outdoor motor ya PCB likha hai, jo indoor coil sensor se match nahi karta - note kar liya gaya. 2021 service manual mein bhi yahi matlab hai (5 kohm ya 20 kohm reference).

title.en: Indoor fan motor error (AC or DC motor)
title.ur: Indoor fan motor ki kharabi (AC ya DC motor)

meaning.en: The indoor board does not receive valid fan speed feedback, so it stops the unit as a fan fault.
meaning.ur: Indoor board ko fan ki speed ka valid feedback nahi milta, is liye yeh ise fan fault samajh kar unit rok deta hai.

causes.en: Fan blade stuck or blocked by dust
causes.ur: Fan blade atak gaya hai ya dhool se block hai

causes.en: Failed PG/DC fan motor or a loose motor connector, or a fault on the indoor board
causes.ur: PG/DC fan motor fail ho gaya, motor connector dheela hai ya indoor board par fault hai

solutions.en: Switch off, clear anything jamming the indoor fan and clean the filters, then restart
solutions.ur: Band karein, indoor fan ko jam karne wali cheez hatayein aur filters saaf karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: If it repeats, have the fan motor feedback and the indoor board tested
solutions.ur: Agar yeh dobara ho to fan motor feedback aur indoor board ko test karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: On floor-standing models the same code can mean a sliding-door position fault (service manual), and its resolvent column mentions module or phase sequence, which looks copied from the F1 row - recorded as a source inconsistency.
notes.ur: Floor-standing models par yehi code sliding-door position fault ka bhi matlab ho sakta hai (service manual), aur uske resolvent column mein module ya phase sequence likha hai jo F1 wali row se copy lagta hai - source inconsistency ke tor par record kiya gaya.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units cannot exchange signals over the inter-unit cable, so the system stops.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units aik doosre ke saath signal exchange nahi kar pa rahe, is liye system ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Loose, burnt or rodent-damaged inter-unit communication wire
causes.ur: Inter-unit communication wire dheela, jala hua ya chuha se kharab ho gaya hai

causes.en: Failed indoor or outdoor main board, or reversed supply polarity confusing the boards
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor main board fail ho gaya, ya supply polarity ulta hone se boards confuse ho gaye

solutions.en: Turn off power at the breaker for ten minutes and restart to clear a one-off communication glitch
solutions.ur: Breaker se das minute ke liye power band karein aur restart karein taake ek dafa ka communication glitch clear ho jaye.

solutions.en: Have the outdoor unit powered up independently and the inter-unit wiring end-to-end checked
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ko alag se power dein aur inter-unit wiring ko end-to-end check karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Fixed-speed indoor LED digit displays show this as 5E, kept as an alias. On the three-LED ODU map the same fault is a dedicated blink pattern. This is the code PK technicians see most after unstable supply or rodent damage on rooftops.
notes.ur: Fixed-speed indoor LED digit display par yeh 5E aata hai, is liye alias mein rakha gaya hai. Three-LED ODU map par yahi fault ka ek khaas blink pattern hai. Yahi code hai jo PK technicians ko rooftop par unstable supply ya chuha damage ke baad sabse zyada nazar aata hai.

title.en: Display board to main PCB communication fault
title.ur: Display board aur main PCB ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: The user display board has lost contact with the indoor main control board.
meaning.ur: User display board ka rabta indoor main control board se poori taraf toot gaya hai.

causes.en: Loose or damaged ribbon/connection line between display and indoor board
causes.ur: Display aur indoor board ke darmiyan ribbon/connection line dheela ya kharab hai

causes.en: Failed display board or failed indoor main board, or the two parts are not a matched pair
causes.ur: Display board ya indoor main board fail ho gaya, ya dono parts matched pair nahi hain

solutions.en: Re-seat the display connection line and restart
solutions.ur: Display connection line ko dobara lagaein aur restart karein.

solutions.en: Swap in a known-good board one at a time to identify which side failed, replacing both if they are unmatched
solutions.ur: Ek ek karke known-good board lagakar pata karein ke kaun si side fail hui; agar dono aapas mein match nahi karte to dono badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Commonly reported on floor-standing cabinets where a separate display board exists. The 2021 service manual has a full section for it with a compatibility warning about unmatched display/main boards.
notes.ur: Floor-standing cabinets par aam tor par aata hai jahan alag display board hota hai. 2021 service manual mein iska poora section hai jismein unmatched display/main boards ki compatibility warning di gayi hai.

title.ur: Indoor unit ka EEPROM (EE) error

meaning.en: The indoor board cannot read its stored parameters chip, so it refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Indoor board apna parameter wala chip parh nahi pa raha, is liye chalne se inkaar kar deta hai.

causes.en: Poor contact on the EE chip socket
causes.ur: EE chip socket par contact theek nahi hai

causes.en: Corrupt or failed EE chip on the indoor main board
causes.ur: Indoor main board ka EE chip corrupt ya fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Power-cycle once and re-seat the EE chip
solutions.ur: Ek dafa power-cycle karein aur EE chip ko dobara lagaein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor main board if the chip cannot be re-read
solutions.ur: Agar chip dobara read na ho to indoor main board badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Service manual inspection path for this code is short and ends at the indoor main control panel.
notes.ur: Is code ka service manual inspection path chhota hai aur indoor main control panel par khatam hota hai.

title.ur: Outdoor fan motor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor board cannot drive or verify the outdoor fan, so the unit stops to protect the condenser side.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board outdoor fan ko chalha ya confirm nahi kar sakta, is liye unit condenser side ki hifazat ke liye ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan jammed by debris or a failed fan motor
causes.ur: Outdoor fan debris ki wajah se jam ho gaya, ya fan motor fail ho gaya hai

causes.en: Damaged motor connector or fault on the outdoor controller
causes.ur: Motor connector kharab hai ya outdoor controller par fault hai

solutions.en: Switch off and clear debris from the outdoor fan, checking that it spins freely
solutions.ur: Band karein aur outdoor fan se debris saaf karein, aur check karein ke fan azaadi se ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Have the fan motor and its connector tested and replace the motor if it is dead
solutions.ur: Fan motor aur uska connector test karwaein aur agar motor dead ho to motor badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: 2021 service manual gives a separate section for 3-wire external DC fan motors (no speed feedback path).
notes.ur: 2021 service manual mein 3-wire external DC fan motors ke liye alag section hai (speed feedback path nahi hai).

title.ur: Outdoor module (IPM) ki protection

meaning.en: The compressor power module detected overcurrent, overvoltage or overheating and shut the compressor down.
meaning.ur: Compressor power module ne overcurrent, overvoltage ya overheating mihsoos ki aur compressor band kar diya.

causes.en: Compressor, IPM module or system blockage
causes.ur: Compressor, IPM module ya system mein blockage

causes.en: Unstable supply voltage, bad compressor wiring or reactor fault
causes.ur: Supply voltage unstable, compressor wiring kharab ya reactor fault

solutions.en: Switch off at the breaker for ten minutes and restart once, watching whether the code returns
solutions.ur: Breaker se das minute ke liye band karein aur ek baar restart karein, nazar karte hue ke code wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Have a technician check supply voltage, compressor wiring and the module board together
solutions.ur: Technician se supply voltage, compressor wiring aur module board sath mein check karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: The 2021 service manual treats F1 as the parent fault for the whole L0-LC subdivision series, and on the three-LED ODU map module protection has its own blink pattern. On poor-grid or ageing units occasional F1 is normal protection behaviour.
notes.ur: 2021 service manual F1 ko poori L0-LC subdivision series ka parent fault manta hai, aur three-LED ODU map par module protection ka apna blink pattern hai. Kharab grid ya purani units par kabhi kabhi F1 aana normal protection behaviour hai.

title.ur: Outdoor ka PFC protection

meaning.en: The power-factor-correction stage of the inverter shut down because of overcurrent or overvoltage.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka power factor correction stage overcurrent ya overvoltage ki wajah se band ho gaya.

causes.en: PFC stage components or reactor damaged
causes.ur: PFC stage ke components ya reactor kharab hain

causes.en: Unstable or out-of-range supply voltage
causes.ur: Supply voltage unstable ya out-of-range hai

solutions.en: Check the mains voltage with a meter before doing anything else
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi karne se pehle meter se mains voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician test the reactor, PFC stage and outdoor board
solutions.ur: Technician se reactor, PFC stage aur outdoor board test karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Official resolvent column lists controller, compressor and compressor exhaust sensor, which is broader than the service manual's PFC path - recorded.
notes.ur: Official resolvent column mein controller, compressor aur compressor exhaust sensor likhe hain, jo service manual ke PFC path se zyada wide hai - record kar liya.

title.en: Compressor start failure or out-of-step operation
title.ur: Compressor ka start fail hona ya out-of-step chalna

meaning.en: The module cannot get the compressor to follow the commanded rotation, so it stops for protection.
meaning.ur: Module compressor ko hukm di gayi rotation ke mutabiq nahi chala pa raha, is liye protection ke liye rok deta hai.

causes.en: Compressor wiring connected in the wrong phase order, or a seized compressor
causes.ur: Compressor wiring ghalat phase order mein lagi hai, ya compressor jam ho gaya hai

causes.en: System blockage or a failed module/driver board
causes.ur: System blockage hai ya module/driver board fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Have a technician swap the compressor phase wires and see whether the code clears
solutions.ur: Technician se compressor phase wires swap karke dekhein ke code clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If wiring is correct, test the compressor winding and the module board
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to compressor winding aur module board test karein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Service manual advises analysing F3 and F1 together because they are the same underlying mechanical abnormality detected at different points.
notes.ur: Service manual F3 aur F1 ko sath mein analysing karne ki salah deta hai, kyunke dono wohi underlying mechanical abnormality hain jo alag alag points par detect hoti hai.

title.ur: Outdoor discharge (exhaust) sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor board reads the compressor discharge temperature sensor as short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board compressor ki discharge temperature sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh raha hai.

causes.en: Discharge sensor failed, damp or with a broken lead
causes.ur: Discharge sensor fail ho gaya, geela hai ya uski lead tooti hui hai

causes.en: Poor terminal contact or a fault on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Terminal ka contact theek nahi hai ya outdoor board par fault hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor connector for damp and corrosion, then restart
solutions.ur: Sensor connector mein geela pan aur zang ke liye check karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure the sensor around its nominal value at room temperature and replace it if it is out of range
solutions.ur: Room temperature par sensor ko uske nominal value ke qareeb measure karein aur agar out-of-range ho to badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Service manual warns that fitting a wrong-value sensor here makes the unit enter high-exhaust protection repeatedly; nominal is around 50 kohm at 25 C.
notes.ur: Service manual warn karta hai ke yahan ghalat value ka sensor lagane se unit baar baar high-exhaust protection mein chali jati hai; nominal taqreeban 25 C par 50 kohm hai.

title.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor board reads the outdoor ambient sensor as short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board outdoor ambient sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh raha hai.

causes.en: Ambient sensor failed or its lead is broken
causes.ur: Ambient sensor fail ho gaya ya uski lead toot gayi hai

causes.en: Damaged wiring or a fault on the outdoor controller
causes.ur: Wiring kharab hai ya outdoor controller par fault hai

solutions.en: Inspect the sensor lead and connector, then restart
solutions.ur: Sensor lead aur connector check karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Replace the ambient sensor if its resistance is out of range
solutions.ur: Agar ambient sensor ki resistance out-of-range hai to sensor badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: The official US cassette line gives F6 as low-pressure protection instead - a real cross-line conflict, see the coverage notes.
notes.ur: Official US cassette line mein F6 ki jagah low-pressure protection likha hai - yeh waqai cross-line conflict hai, coverage notes dekhein.

title.en: Outdoor main PCB to module board communication error
title.ur: Outdoor main PCB aur module board ki communication error

meaning.en: On models with a separate module board, the two outdoor boards stopped exchanging data.
meaning.ur: Jin models par alag module board hota hai, un mein do outdoor boards ka data lena dena band ho gaya.

causes.en: Loose or damaged communication data line between the boards
causes.ur: Boards ke darmiyan communication data line dheela ya kharab hai

causes.en: Failed module board or failed outdoor main board
causes.ur: Module board ya outdoor main board fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Re-seat the data connector and check for a broken wire
solutions.ur: Data connector dobara lagaein aur tooti hui wire ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Test with a known-good module board to isolate which board failed
solutions.ur: Known-good module board se test karke alag karein ke kaun sa board fail hua.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Only applies where module and main outdoor boards are physically separate - not single-board outdoor units.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf unhi units par lagu hota hai jahan module aur main outdoor boards alag alag hon; single-board outdoor units par nahi.

title.ur: Outdoor unit ka EEPROM (EE) error

meaning.en: The outdoor board cannot read its stored parameters chip.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board apna parameter wala chip parh nahi pa raha.

causes.en: Poor contact on the EE chip
causes.ur: EE chip par contact theek nahi hai

causes.en: Failed or corrupt EE chip on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Outdoor board ka EE chip fail ya corrupt ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Power-cycle and re-seat the EE chip
solutions.ur: Power-cycle karein aur EE chip ko dobara lagaein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor controller if the chip still cannot be read
solutions.ur: Agar chip phir bhi read na ho to outdoor controller badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Shown as its own blink pattern on the three-LED outdoor map.
notes.ur: Three-LED outdoor map par apne alag blink pattern mein dikhaya jata hai.

title.ur: Suction / recirculated air sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The return-air (suction) sensor used for electronic expansion valve control is reading out of range.
meaning.ur: Electronic expansion valve control ke liye jo return-air (suction) sensor istemal hota hai wo range se bahar parh raha hai.

causes.en: Return-air sensor failed or disconnected
causes.ur: Return-air sensor fail ho gaya ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Four-way valve or sensor wiring fault on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Outdoor board par four-way valve ya sensor wiring fault hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor lead and its connector seating
solutions.ur: Sensor lead aur uske connector ki seating check karein.

solutions.en: Swap with a known-good sensor and replace it if the code follows the sensor
solutions.ur: Known-good sensor ke sath swap karein aur agar code sensor ke sath chala jaye to sensor badal dein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Service manual restricts this code to models with an electronic expansion valve and calls it a four-way valve switch error as well.
notes.ur: Service manual is code ko sirf electronic expansion valve wali models tak seemit karta hai aur ise four-way valve switch error bhi kehta hai.

title.en: Floor-standing indoor DC fan motor error
title.ur: Floor-standing indoor DC fan motor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor DC fan on a floor-standing cabinet is not running or not reporting speed feedback.
meaning.ur: Floor-standing cabinet ka indoor DC fan nahi chalta, ya speed feedback nahi de raha.

causes.en: Fan motor jammed, failed or with a loose terminal
causes.ur: Fan motor jam ho gaya, fail hai ya terminal dheela hai

causes.en: Fault on the indoor main board
causes.ur: Indoor main board par fault hai

solutions.en: Clear anything blocking the cabinet fan and re-seat the motor connector
solutions.ur: Cabinet fan ko block karne wali cheez hatayein aur motor connector dobara lagaein.

solutions.en: Have the DC motor and indoor board tested together
solutions.ur: DC motor aur indoor board ko sath mein test karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Only the official global/Thailand tables carry Fb; the 2021 service manual index lists it but points at the E4 troubleshooting section instead.
notes.ur: Sirf official global/Thailand tables mein Fb hai; 2021 service manual index mein yeh to likha hai magar E4 troubleshooting section ki taraf point karta hai.

title.ur: High-pressure switch ki protection

meaning.en: The high-pressure switch opened repeatedly within about twenty minutes, so the unit locked out.
meaning.ur: High-pressure switch ne taqreeban bis minute ke andar baar baar khul gaya, is liye unit lock ho gaya.

causes.en: Blocked condenser or a failed outdoor fan raising system pressure
causes.ur: Condenser block hai ya outdoor fan fail hone se system pressure barh raha hai

causes.en: Faulty high-pressure switch or poor switch wiring
causes.ur: High-pressure switch kharab hai ya switch wiring theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Clean the outdoor condenser coil and confirm the outdoor fan runs, then restart
solutions.ur: Outdoor condenser coil saaf karein aur confirm karein ke outdoor fan chal raha hai, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician measure operating pressure and test the switch
solutions.ur: Technician se operating pressure measure karwaein aur switch test karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Service manual counts three switch openings inside twenty minutes as the trigger.
notes.ur: Service manual ke mutabiq bees minute ke andar teen switch openings ko trigger manta hai.

title.ur: Refrigerant kam hone se protection

meaning.en: The system holds less than roughly a third of its charge, so it stopped instead of running dry.
meaning.ur: System mein charge taqreeban ek teesai se bhi kam hai, is liye sukha chalne ke bajaye yeh ruka.

causes.en: Leak in the copper pipework or a loose flare at the outdoor service valves
causes.ur: Copper pipework mein leak hai ya outdoor service valves par flare dheela hai

causes.en: Unit shipped or charged short, or valves not fully opened
causes.ur: Unit kam gas ke sath aayi hai, ya valves poori tarah khole nahi gaye

solutions.en: Open the outdoor service valves fully and look for oil marks or bubbles at the joints
solutions.ur: Outdoor service valves poori tarah kholein aur joints par oil marks ya bubbles dekhein.

solutions.en: Stop the unit and have a technician find the leak, repair it and re-gas
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur technician se leak check karwa kar theek karwayein, phir dobara gas bharwayein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Running a unit low on gas risks compressor damage, so severity is stop-and-call rather than a simple restart. PK retailer content also warns Pakistani users about low-gas codes, but that article is brand-agnostic.
notes.ur: Kam gas par unit chalane se compressor kharab ho sakta hai, isliye severity simple restart nahi balkay stop-and-call hai. PK retailer content Pakistani users ko low-gas codes ke bare mein warn karta hai, lekin woh article brand-agnostic hai.

title.ur: Cooling mein condenser ki overload protection

meaning.en: The outdoor coil ran too hot, so the controller cut the compressor frequency to protect it.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil bohat zyada garam ho gayi, is liye controller ne compressor ki frequency kam kar di taaki uski hifazat ho.

causes.en: Dirty or blocked condenser coil or a weak outdoor fan
causes.ur: Condenser coil ganda ya block hai, ya outdoor fan kamzor hai

causes.en: Outdoor coil sensor reading wrongly, or a divider-resistance fault on the controller
causes.ur: Outdoor coil sensor ghalat reading de raha hai, ya controller par divider-resistance fault hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser coil and confirm the outdoor fan reaches full speed
solutions.ur: Condenser coil saaf karein aur confirm karein ke outdoor fan full speed par aa jata hai.

solutions.en: Have the outdoor coil sensor checked and replaced if it reads out of range
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil sensor check karwaein aur agar reading out-of-range ho to sensor badalwayein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Very common in dusty PK installations where the outdoor coil is never washed.
notes.ur: Dusty PK installations mein yeh bohat aam hai jahan outdoor coil kabhi dhoya nahi jata.

title.ur: Discharge temperature ki protection

meaning.en: Compressor discharge temperature exceeded the limit, so the unit shut down to protect the compressor.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge temperature had se zyada ho gayi, is liye unit ne compressor ki hifazat ke liye apne aap ko band kar liya.

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge or restricted airflow at the indoor or outdoor side
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam hai ya indoor/outdoor side par airflow restricted hai

causes.en: Discharge sensor reading high, or a stuck expansion device
causes.ur: Discharge sensor zyada reading de raha hai, ya expansion device atka hua hai

solutions.en: Turn the unit off, clean both filters and the indoor/outdoor coils, then restart
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, dono filters aur indoor/outdoor coils saaf karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician verify the charge and the discharge sensor reading
solutions.ur: Technician se charge aur discharge sensor ki reading verify karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Related to F4, which reports the sensor itself failing rather than the temperature limit.
notes.ur: Yeh F4 se related hai jo sensor khud fail hone par report karta hai, temperature limit par nahi.

title.ur: Heating mein indoor high-temperature se protection

meaning.en: The indoor coil temperature rose past the safe limit during heating, so the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Heating ke doran indoor coil ki temperature mehfuz had se upar chali gayi, is liye unit ruka.

causes.en: Reduced indoor airflow from a clogged filter or blocked indoor fan
causes.ur: Filter ganda hone ya indoor fan block hone se indoor airflow kam ho gayi hai

causes.en: Indoor coil sensor reading high or a controller fault
causes.ur: Indoor coil sensor zyada reading de raha hai ya controller fault hai

solutions.en: Clean or replace the filters and clear the indoor air path, then restart
solutions.ur: Filters saaf karein ya badal dein aur indoor air path khali karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Have the indoor coil sensor measured and replaced if it does not match
solutions.ur: Indoor coil sensor measure karwaein aur agar match na kare to sensor badalwayein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Official table labels this as the heating-mode overload case; P7 is its cooling-mode counterpart.
notes.ur: Official table mein yeh heating-mode overload case hai; P7 iska cooling-mode counterpart hai.

title.ur: Cooling mein indoor anti-freezing se protection

meaning.en: The indoor coil got cold enough to risk freezing, so the unit shut down to protect the evaporator.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil itni thandi ho gayi ke us par jamne ka khatra banta hai, is liye unit ne evaporator ki hifazat ke liye apne aap ko band kar liya.

causes.en: Clogged indoor filters or a weak indoor fan lowering airflow
causes.ur: Indoor filters block hain ya indoor fan kamzor hone se airflow kam ho rahi hai

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge, or a failing indoor coil sensor
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam hai, ya indoor coil sensor fail hone laga hai

solutions.en: Switch off, clean the filters and the indoor coil, then restart and check airflow
solutions.ur: Band karein, filters aur indoor coil saaf karein, phir restart karke airflow check karein.

solutions.en: If it returns, have the charge and the indoor coil sensor checked
solutions.ur: Agar yeh wapas aaye to charge aur indoor coil sensor check karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Service manual inspection path runs from the indoor air inlet through the filter, fan and indoor coil sensor.
notes.ur: Service manual ka inspection path indoor air inlet se shuru hota hai aur filter, fan aur indoor coil sensor tak jata hai.

title.ur: Outdoor unit ka overcurrent protection

meaning.en: The outdoor controller measured bus current above its set limit and cut the frequency to bring it down.
meaning.ur: Outdoor controller ne bus current apni set ki had se zyada parha aur usay kam karne ke liye frequency ghatayi.

causes.en: System blockage forcing the compressor to work against high load
causes.ur: System blockage ki wajah se compressor high load par kaam kar raha hai

causes.en: Grid voltage outside the expected range, or a failing outdoor controller
causes.ur: Grid voltage expected range se bahar hai, ya outdoor controller fail ho raha hai

solutions.en: Measure the mains voltage before restarting, and restart only once
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle mains voltage measure karein, aur sirf ek dafa restart karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician check for blockage and test the outdoor controller
solutions.ur: Technician se blockage check karwaein aur outdoor controller test karwaein.

source.title: AUX Global - Error Codes (IDU Error Code List)

notes.en: Distinct from E0, which is the indoor-side overcurrent case.
notes.ur: Yeh E0 se alag hai jo indoor-side overcurrent case hai.
